requirements.label: FacadeBIM_Panel.PanelID
requirements.description: PanelID data shall be {'pattern': '[SENW]-(L[1-8]|RF)-[0-9]{2}'} and in the dataset FacadeBIM_Panel

requirements.label: FacadeBIM_Panel.PanelType
requirements.description: PanelType data shall be {'enumeration': ['U1', 'U2', 'U3', 'U4', 'U5']} and in the dataset FacadeBIM_Panel

requirements.label: FacadeBIM_Panel.InstallDate
requirements.description: InstallDate data shall be {'pattern': '[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'} and in the dataset FacadeBIM_Panel

requirements.label: FacadeBIM_Panel.DeliveryDate
requirements.description: DeliveryDate data shall be {'pattern': '[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'} and in the dataset FacadeBIM_Panel

requirements.label: FacadeBIM_Panel.Stillage
requirements.description: Stillage data shall be {'pattern': 'ST-[0-9]{3}'} and in the dataset FacadeBIM_Panel

requirements.label: FacadeBIM_RhinoUserText.pid
requirements.description: pid data shall be {'pattern': '[SENW]-(L[1-8]|RF)-[0-9]{2}'} and in the dataset FacadeBIM_RhinoUserText

requirements.label: FacadeBIM_Part.MaterialName
